title.narrative: Expansion of stop TB strategy; reaching the hard to reach and preventing missed opportunities - Eritrea (01-Jan-2014-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: The fight against Tuberculosis (TB) has been and still remains a major health intervention in Eritrea’s goal for a healthy population. Eritrea has a countrywide DOTS coverage of 100% and treatment success rate of 85% surveys ; however, the country has not achieved the WHO stop TB targets of case detection rate of 70%. This Program is a consolidation of Round 10 and Round 6 TB grants. The Round 10 seeks to improve access to TB diagnosis and monitoring. The proposal is consistent with Eritrea’s National Strategic Plan and is designed to fill gaps and overcome weaknesses in the response to Eritrea’s TB epidemic, while complementing the Round 6 program as well as other investments. The goal of the Program is to significantly reduce the burden and the transmission of tuberculosis in line with the Millennium Development Goals and the STOP TB partnership targets so that TB no longer remains a public health problem in Eritrea. The Program targets TB suspects & TB Patients; prisoners, prison staff and their family members; general population; and health promoters and health staff.
